Class PraxisBulkWebAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.configuration.PraxisBulkWebAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(after=OpenApiUiSchemaAutoConfiguration.class) @ConditionalOnWebApplication(type=SERVLET) public class PraxisBulkWebAutoConfiguration extends Object
